column1: H3-REF1Obstacle presenceBraking-relevant obstacle condition presentBraking-relevant obstacle condition absentFMEA false-positive/ghost-object effects; FTA object/lidar/image detection failuresMultiple independent downstream mechanisms can create evidence of a non-existent obstacle, establishing obstacle presence versus absence as relevant to unintended braking.

H3-REF2Braking-relevant spatial relationSpatial relation justifies brakingSpatial relation does not justify brakingFMEA distance measured too low; wrong object positioning; localization/distance failuresDownstream evidence shows that distortion of the ego-object spatial relation can create an unjustified braking condition, establishing the braking-relevant spatial separation without requiring a numerical threshold.
